ns2:section.sectionText: This course will cover a variety of topics designed to help students learn more about, and be better prepared to enter, the advertising industry as professionals. Course content will include an overview of career opportunities available in the field of advertising, successful strategies for obtaining and building careers in the industry, as well as interactive sessions with advertising professionals. This course will also contain a week of field study in Atlanta, GA where the class will meet with industry professionals at advertising agencies, social/media companies, clients, and other industry companies. Prerequisites: ADV 300 (or 150) or ADV 199 (Hall or Clifton). Students must apply for this course through the Department, and must have consent of instructor to register.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
